[[File:Star Wars Unlimited card back.png|thumb|right|200px|Card back.]]
'''''Star Wars'': Unlimited''' is a trading card game published by Fantasy Flight Games, part of Asmodee. Its first set, ''Spark of Rebellion'', was released on 8 March 2024.<ref name="sor" /> It is a different game from [[Star Wars CCG]]. Some SWCCG players also play it.

== Gameplay ==
Premier is the main constructed format. Each deck has at least 50 cards plus one leader and one base; a player wins a game by destroying the opponent's base (about 30 hit points).<ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Unlimited Star Wars: Unlimited], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260403001045/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars:_Unlimited Internet Archive]</ref> The leader is a double-sided card that starts undeployed and can later enter play as a unit. Units fight in two arenas, ground and space. Cards from the deck are placed face-down as resources. During the Action Phase players alternate single actions (play a unit, event or upgrade; attack; use an ability) until both pass.<ref name="wp" /> The Regroup Phase is draw, optionally resource one card from hand, and ready exhausted cards.<ref name="wp" />

== Organized play ==
Fantasy Flight Games and Asmodee held the first Galactic Championship at The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas on 25–27 July 2025, advertised for over 2,000 players.<ref name="gc">[https://starwarsunlimited.com/articles/an-event-of-galactic-proportions An Event of Galactic Proportions], starwarsunlimited.com (5 February 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260313053626/https://starwarsunlimited.com/articles/an-event-of-galactic-proportions Internet Archive]</ref> Competitive events include Planetary Qualifiers, Sector Qualifiers and Regional Championships, with standings on melee.gg.
